request:
Consider the agent classes defined in non-test code that directly subclass BaseAgent from auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py (every file under a tests/ folder, conftest.py and helpers included, is test code). Which of these agent classes are constructed (the class is called by name, e.g. ResponseAgent()) somewhere in non-test code but are never constructed anywhere in test code? Count only direct constructor calls written in a function or method body; patching or referencing a class without calling it does not count, and a test that calls a function which constructs the class does not count as constructing it. Return their class symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds BaseAgent's symbol, then its direct subclasses in non-test files, excluding tests/, conftest.py and helpers. It keeps classes that appear as a callee in at least one non-test call and never as a callee in any test call, returning their class symbol IDs.
